scope: Complete public MSNumpressCoder scientific/transport operations using existing config and raw codecs, owned results, explicit skipped/rejected encoding diagnostics. No mzML adapter wiring.

literal_evidence.large_series: Source setup_test_vec2 100-value formula and base64 length/absolute/relative assertions; no new numeric production-derived oracle.

derived_transport.method: Python stdlib zlib.compress of independently projected source raw byte literals, then base64.b64encode. Tests decode this independent fixture; no compressed-writer byte equality claimed.

source_policies: Empty input precedes NONE; raw skip/rejection preserves destination, base64 wrapper completed skip/rejection clears it.
Linear desired-accuracy negative factor falls back to maximal factor; zero factor does not.
Verification only for tolerance>0; nonpositive and NaN disable, positive infinity enables without a finite error cap.
Reverse-index checking; PIC absolute error>=1; others finite then zero-special-case abs or abs(1-original/decoded)>tolerance.
f32 promotion is exact and happens before raw encoder even for NONE.
Raw decode empty/NONE returns empty; transport decode runs before NONE; base64 input shorter than4bytes returns empty.
native_boundaries: Typed encoding reports replace stderr; no fallback to ordinary IEEE binary encoding.
Raw finite/cast/resource rules retained. Raw returned errors become explicit codec rejections as source catchall; wrapper budget and transport failures areErr.
Budget/transport errors preserve caller outputs; decoder errors are atomic rather than clear-before-read.
Strict standard base64 alphabet, length, padding and pad bits beyond preserved short-input shortcut.
Strict single zlib frame CRC/structure/progress with trailing or concatenated input rejected.
Per-operation shared work/allocation includes promotion, estimation/fallback, codec, verification, base64 and zlib; raw local bounds do not reset it.
Wrapper standalone decoding conservatively precharges decoded upper-bound allocation before raw exact-count validation.

validation.independent_review: Chemistry agent reviewed complete wrapper arithmetic, tolerance, destination behavior, transport and shared precharges; no actionable findings.
